registered_correction: The v0.3 50% optimizer-transfer threshold was arbitrary. Version 0.4 uses per-stream first-passage times of a monotone certificate margin and no crossing-fraction gate.

registry.reuse: Exact v0.3a 64-outcome proxy, three hidden error populations, and 20 proxy-only policies.

audit_dynamics.allocation: equal Bonferroni allocation over 2 sampled moments times 16 registered checkpoints
audit_dynamics.monotone_envelope: running minimum of all valid upper bounds observed up to each checkpoint
audit_dynamics.crossing_rule: first checkpoint where max_q(proxy_gain - envelope_radius_q * dual_movement_q) is strictly positive
audit_dynamics.reversion_rule: mathematically prohibited by the monotone envelope and tested exhaustively

oracle_classification.oracle_margin: same maximum lower bound with exact finite-population L1, L2, and Linfinity error norms
oracle_classification.budget_censored: oracle_margin > 0 and no observed crossing by the registered audit cap
oracle_classification.crossed: observed first positive margin by the cap

gates.G0_registration_binding: Protocol, claim packet, prior art, implementation, tests, verifier, and README are committed and hash-bound before execution.
gates.G1_simultaneous_instrument: For each hidden error population, the one-sided 95% exact binomial upper bound on streams with any simultaneous-envelope failure is at most 0.07.
gates.G2_monotone_dynamics: Every certificate-margin trajectory is nondecreasing on the complete registered grid.
gates.G3_conditional_soundness: No true-gain-nonpositive policy crosses on any stream whose simultaneous norm instrument is valid.
gates.G4_oracle_consistency: Every policy is assigned exactly one oracle class and every structurally_uncertifiable policy has no positive oracle margin.
gates.G5_top_spike_liveness: At least one diffuse-error top-spike stream crosses by the audit cap; the complete crossing distribution is reported with no crossing-fraction pass threshold.
gates.G6_no_reversion: No policy/stream returns to non-positive margin after its first positive margin.
gates.G7_resources_and_receipts: The run remains under CPU/RAM ceilings and emits write-once result, condition, policy, crossing-CDF, report, and receipt artifacts.

decision_rule.threshold_censored: G0 through G4, G6, and G7 pass but G5 fails
decision_rule.not_established: G1, G2, G3, G4, or G6 fails

claim_boundary: Synthetic finite-population first-passage audit thresholds under a finite-grid simultaneous Hoeffding instrument; no learned reward model, no universal sequential-optimality claim, and no ASMP-8 resolution.
